ratings.justification: other: The workers render a preview of every PDF asset (uploaded, or a URL that returns a PDF when a user bookmarks it) with pdf2pic, which pipes the bytes to `gm convert` on stdin with no format prefix, so GraphicsMagick picks the decoder by magic bytes: a crafted file served as a PDF reaches its AVIF reader (libheif, which links libaom as one of its AV1 decoders). An invalid read in libaom's frame buffer handling can crash the job. Reaching it needs a signed-in user (Authentik) to save or upload the file; the container runs as root inside the Karakeep VM. Risk here: low. Action: goes away with a rebuilt Debian base (libaom3 deb12u fixes).
